description: Rede Brasileira de Monitoramento Contínuo dos Sistemas GNSS (RBMC) - Ref 30SET2021 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Fornece informações sobre estações geodésicas "ativas" que compõem a Rede Brasileira de Monitoramento Contínuo dos Sistemas GNSS, pertencentes ao Sistema Geodésico Brasileiro (SGB), conforme situação extraída do Banco de Dados Geodésicos (BDG) em 30/09/2021. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Geodésia, Planialtimetria, RBMC, Ativa, GNSS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
